# Ask Data Dawn

> > A career-focused newsletter by Dawn Choo providing interview preparation guides, portfolio project ideas, and job market insights for aspiring data scientists and analysts.

Ask Data Dawn is a curated resource for landing data science and analytics roles, featuring technical interview frameworks, career stories from top tech companies like Amazon and Meta, and in-demand skill guides. The newsletter combines practical preparation strategies with real-world career advice to help readers navigate the competitive data job market.

## Key Topics

- SQL
- Interview Preparation
- Python
- Machine Learning
- Portfolio Projects
- Data Science Skills
- Data Analyst Skills
- Career Guidance
- Technical Interview Prep
- Amazon
- Meta
- Google
- ChatGPT & Claude
- A/B Testing
- Kaggle

## Interview Preparation & Technical Skills

- [How to smash a SQL interview](https://ask-data-dawn.beehiiv.com/p/how-to-smash-a-sql-interview): SQL interview framework from Google, Meta, Amazon offers
- [Only have 7 days to prepare for a Technical interview? Here's exactly how to do it.](https://ask-data-dawn.beehiiv.com/p/only-have-7-days-to-prepare-for-a-technical-interview-here-s-exactly-how-to-do-it-0944): 7-day technical interview prep guide using Claude and ChatGPT
- ["Winging it" is killing your career. 5 tools I use to overprepare for Data Science interviews.](https://ask-data-dawn.beehiiv.com/p/winging-it-is-killing-your-career-5-tools-i-use-to-overprepare-for-data-science-interviews): Interview prep tools: Glassdoor, DataCamp, Interview Master
- [20 (somewhat Advanced) SQL Questions and Answers](https://ask-data-dawn.beehiiv.com/p/20-somewhat-advanced-sql-questions-answers): Advanced SQL practice: window functions and interview prep
- [The 5 Most Common Interview Mistakes](https://ask-data-dawn.beehiiv.com/p/the-5-most-common-interview-mistakes): Common data interview mistakes and communication tips
